description: This file contains unit tests for the Message class within the Goteo application, testing message creation, retrieval, counting, deletion, and auto-expiry behavior.

classes.name: MessageTest
classes.description: Test class for the Message component, extending PHPUnit's TestCase to verify message handling behaviors.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests that a Message object instance can be created and is of the correct type, then clears all messages.

methods.name: testAdder
methods.description: Tests adding info and error messages and verifying the total message count.

methods.name: testGetter
methods.description: Verifies that message retrieval methods return the correct number of messages.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a message and verifying the message count updates accordingly.

methods.name: testGetterAutoexpire
methods.description: Tests automatic message expiration and retrieval after auto-expiry mechanisms.
